after_nodes = {n['id']: n for n in after['nodes']}

        print(f"  Node {nid}: {bn['color']}({bn['pixels']}) -> {an['color']}({an['pixels']})")

# Check white and gray diamond positions
print("\n=== White and Gray diamonds ===")
for n in after['nodes']:
    if n['color'] in ['W', 'G'] and n['pixels'] >= 10:
        bnd = n['boundary']
        center_r = sum(p[0] for p in bnd) / len(bnd)
        center_c = sum(p[1] for p in bnd) / len(bnd)
        print(f"  {n['color']}: pixels={n['pixels']}, center≈({center_r:.0f},{center_c:.0f})")
</parameter>
